title: News: $672M of leveraged bets wiped out in a day

linkedin.text:
In the last 24 hours, about $672 million of leveraged crypto positions were wiped out.

Bitcoin slipped from roughly $84,200 to near $81,000. Not a crash by crypto standards. But for people trading with borrowed money, a move that size is enough.

Here is what happened, in plain words. Traders borrowed to make bigger bets. When the price moved against them, the exchange closed their positions automatically to recover the loan. That is a liquidation. About $586 million of the total came from people betting on prices going up.

The lesson is not that crypto is dangerous. It is that leverage turns a normal dip into a total loss. The same 4% move that a spot holder can sit through can erase a 20x position completely.

Today at 1:30 PM Lagos time, the US publishes its inflation number for September. Expect more swings either way.

If you are new: learn first, size small, and never put borrowed money into a market you are still learning.

Education, not financial advice.
